newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Meralco B up 4.72 pct on technical bounce.
newsitem.headline: Meralco B up 4.72 pct on technical bounce.

text.p: Power distributor Manila Electric Corp B shares jumped six pesos, or 4.72 percent, to 133 pesos in late Thursday trade due to a technical rebound helped by expectations of improved second quarter earnings, brokers said.

"In a market like this, you'll see a number of shares with a lot of values catching the eye of investors. Latest figures showed exports picked up and this means that there's an improvement in the performance of the industrial sector," said Noel Reyes, vice-president at Anscor Hagedorn Securities.
